mission: Expand the Experimental scientific method branch in atlas domain roots using four publicly accessible, previously unrequested primary sources. Investigate distinct evidence concerning randomized blocking and nuisance-variable control, prospective hypothesis testing and preregistration, false-positive inflation from flexible analysis, and empirical replication outcomes. Preserve each source's population, design, methodological assumptions, statistical limitations and historical context. Distinguish methodological recommendations from demonstrated experimental results, and distinguish replication outcomes from judgments about scientific truth. Candidate construction must use the compiler-retained captures and must not infer taxonomy, causal relationships, universal applicability, consensus or current-frontier status. Do not overwrite the existing broad method.scientific record with narrower findings.
